The '''Belsallian Sea''' was a body of water located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] in the [[Serenno system/Legends|Serenno system]]<ref name=":0">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 1|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 1]]</ref> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The planetary capital during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Carannia/Legends|Carannia]], was located upon its shore.<ref name=":0" />

The Belsallian Sea contained [[Otoh Dooku]] and the [[Demurra Trench]].<ref name="AoE 4">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 4|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 4]]</ref>

Belsallian seafarers used the saying “There’s always a bigger [[Fish/Legends|fish]].”<ref>{{SW|url=news/so-uncivilized-great-gunslingers-in-star-wars-part-1|series=So Uncivilized: Great Gunslingers in Star Wars|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Belsallian sea was first mentioned and shown in the comic [[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire|''Star Wars: Agent of the Empire'']] during the [[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets|Hard Targets]] arc's [[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 1|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 1]], written by [[John Ostrander]] and illustrated by [[Davidé Fabbri|Davide Fabbri]], which was published in [[2012]]. The edge of the sea was pictured briefly during a fight between the series protagonist [[Jahan Cross]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] taking place in Carannia.<ref name=":0" />
